description: Start an interactive architecture consultation. Supply repository-relative file paths and known project context. Returns prioritized files to read, review areas, and up to three follow-up questions. Covers the whole application, including Next.js apps, not only infrastructure or scaling.

accessControl.description: Identity, roles, tenant boundaries, and where authorization is enforced

constraints.description: Team, budget, delivery constraints, and alternatives being considered

criticalFlows.description: Important user journeys and business invariants

data.description: Database ownership, sensitive data, and consistency requirements

deployment.description: Hosting, runtimes, regions, and external services

purpose.description: Who uses the application and what it must do

reliability.description: Availability and recovery goals, failure handling, and monitoring

rendering.description: SEO, interactivity, freshness, and caching requirements

testing.description: Critical-flow tests and the latest build/test results

filePaths.description: Repository file inventory, relative to the application package root; use the client's workspace tools to list files

name: plan_architecture_review
title: Plan a whole-application architecture review
